title: Join FYI Yachts at FLIBS: Discover Our Unique Offerings!
description: We're excited to invite you to the Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show (FLIBS), where you can dive into the world of FYI Yachts...

We’re excited to invite you to the Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show (FLIBS), where you can dive into the world of FYI Yachts. Our team is ready to showcase the craftsmanship and innovation that define our listings. Visit us at Bahia Mar Yachting Center, Dock H, to see our much-anticipated lineup, including the 2025 57′ FYI and the sleek 2025 52′ FYI, both designed for those who appreciate the finer things in life on the water.

To make your visit even better, we’re offering complimentary tickets to the show. Reach out to us today to grab your pass and explore our vessels up close. Our knowledgeable team will be on hand to discuss the unique features and benefits of our yachts, ensuring you have a memorable experience. We look forward to welcoming you to the FYI Yachts family!
